summary: Adams Street Credit Solutions Fund, a Delaware private credit BDC trading as a continuously offered non-listed vehicle (no exchange listing, no ticker), filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly operations. Under Item 3.02, the Company sold 17,386.585 Class I common shares for approximately $350,000 in its continuous private offering, priced at NAV per share ($20.13 as of August 31, 2026, roughly $20.13), exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S. Item 8.01 disclosed August 31 NAV and a $0.15 monthly Class I distribution payable October 8, 2026 to holders of record September 24. Aggregate NAV was about $67.2 million. No special situation, no advisor, no board recommendation, no deal terms.
